verdict.rationale: Caching resolved actions or generated code for deterministic replay is a fair axis for a browser-automation API for AI agents, but the evidence shows no such capability. Reusing auth context across sessions, session replay recordings, and agent trace exports are adjacent features: they avoid repeated logins or record what happened, but they do not replay cached actions in place of re-prompting the LLM.

support.subject: As a developer, I can cache resolved actions or generated code so repeat runs replay deterministically at lower cost and latency than re-prompting the LLM
